payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate i from 0 to n, the count of digit a; compute sum = i*a+(n-i)*b; check if sum's digits are only a or b; add C(n,i) mod MOD.
payload.rationale: Enumerates all possible distributions of digits a and b by varying their counts, not generating all strings directly. Uses factorial precomputation and modular inverse for combinations, fitting permutation/combination enumeration subtype.
